items.reason: The newly added terminate() signals shutdown but never joins the commit thread (src/sentry/remote_subscriptions/consumers/queue_consumer.py:340-342). The loop does not recheck shutdown after wait(), so an in-flight iteration can retrieve offsets and call commit_function after terminate() returns and partitions are revoked (queue_consumer.py:274-287). It eventually exits, but the missing synchronization creates a real late-commit race.
